description: This Java source file defines the `EwayServices` class which provides static methods to handle payment operations such as charge, refund, and release (void) transactions via the eWAY payment gateway within the Apache OFBiz framework. The class interacts with other OFBiz components and external services to process credit card payments, refunds, and voids, and manages request initialization, response processing, and configuration retrieval.

classes.name: EwayServices
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for processing payments, refunds, and releases via the eWAY gateway in the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: ewayCharge
methods.description: Processes an authorization with capture for a credit card transaction through eWAY, constructing the request with payment and customer details, sending it, and returning the transaction results including authorization and capture info.

methods.name: ewayRefund
methods.description: Issues a refund for a previously captured transaction via eWAY, retrieving the original transaction and credit card details, then sending a refund request and returning the response.

methods.name: ewayRelease
methods.description: Performs a void (release) of an authorized transaction via eWAY, sending the request with relevant details and returning the processing outcome.

methods.name: initRequest
methods.description: Initializes a GatewayRequest object with configuration and settings based on the provided context; differentiates between refund and non-refund requests.

methods.name: getPaymentGatewayConfigValue
methods.description: Retrieves payment gateway configuration values either from a specific configuration entity or resource properties, used during request initialization.
